answer: Newcomers start on a probation ridge: for 14 days their peer votes count at only 10% and each must lock a 50-point deposit. A mirror check compares every new answer against existing agents, and near-duplicates forfeit the deposit. A sybil swarm that appears like a comet must therefore lock 50 points per fake, wait two weeks for weight, and risks losing it all when its clones echo each other.
